alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced in 3mM dithiothreitol at 60˚C for 10 mins and alkylated in the dark for 30 mins with 9mM Iodoacetamide (Sigma).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were reduced in 3mM dithiothreitol at 60˚C for 10 mins and alkylated in the dark for 30 mins with 9mM Iodoacetamide (Sigma).

cleavage_agent.evidence: In-situ protein digestion on the ProteoMiner™ beads was undertaken by incubating samples under continuous rotation at 37˚C in 2µg of sequencing grade trypsin for 2 hours.

ionization_type.evidence: Search parameters used were: peptide mass tolerances, 10 ppm; fragment mass tolerance, 0.01 Da; 2+ and 3+ ions; missed cleavages, 1; enzyme, trypsin; instrument type, ESI-FTICR.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: analysed using a 2-h gradient on a NanoAcquity™ ultraperformance LC (Waters, Manchester, UK) coupled online to a Q-Exactive Quadrupole-Orbitrap instrument (Thermo-Fisher Scientific Hemel Hempstead, UK) as described previously.

ptm.evidence: Modifications included were: fixed carbamidomethyl cysteine and variable oxidation of methionine, lysine, and proline.
